data.name: Retract
data.description: Retract is a Boulder, Colorado-based early-stage startup that describes itself as a developer, constructor, and operator of direct air capture and sequestration facilities. The company is very small (LinkedIn lists 2-10 employees) with no public news, funding announcements, or registry activity found via web search. Operational status is unclear beyond a minimal web/LinkedIn presence and a Crunchbase profile listing co-founder John H. Switzer.
